newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares close IBIS trade up around new highs.
newsitem.headline: German shares close IBIS trade up around new highs.

text.p: 1513 GMT - German shares end electronic trading close to new record highs set earlier after Tuesday Fed decision not to increase U.S. interest rates triggers renewed buying interest. But dealers say the relative market illiquidity coming from low volumes contributes to the scale of the gains.
* IBIS DAX index of all-day electronic trade up 29.68 points to 2,663.10, nudging slightly ahead of DAX close but just down on new all-time record of 2,665.65
* Dealers say new gains could be limited by slightly easier dollar, which now trading at 1.5100 after U.S. rate hold.
* Investor buying in individual said restricted.
